events.description: Ross Geller asks where Dr. Baldhara’s zoo is located.
Dr. Baldhara says Dr. Baldhara’s facility is not a zoo but an interactive wildlife experience.
Dr. Baldhara asks Ross Geller some questions about Marcel, Ross Geller’s monkey.
Dr. Baldhara asks whether Marcel fights with other animals.
Ross Geller says Marcel is very docile.
Dr. Baldhara asks whether Marcel would remain docile if Marcel were cornered.
Ross Geller says he does not know how Marcel would react if cornered and asks why Dr. Baldhara wants to know.
Dr. Baldhara asks how Marcel handles small objects.
Ross Geller says Marcel can hold a banana.
Ross Geller asks if holding a banana is what Dr. Baldhara means by handling small objects.
Ross Geller asks why Marcel would need a blade.

Dr. Baldhara says that if Marcel is up against a jungle cat or a horned animal, Ross Geller should give Marcel a weapon, such as a hammer or a small blade, because leaving Marcel unarmed would be cruel.
Chandler Bing and Joey Tribbiani announce that Marcel got into San Diego.
Joey Tribbiani says he and Chandler Bing came back from their walk.
Joey Tribbiani says the phone was ringing when he and Chandler Bing returned.
Chandler Bing says Marcel has been accepted to San Diego.
Ross Geller tells Marcel to listen to the news that Marcel got into San Diego.
Dr. Baldhara tells Ross Geller that Ross Geller is making a big mistake.
Dr. Baldhara says he means that Ross Geller is making a big mistake.
Dr. Baldhara says San Diego is all well and good.
Dr. Baldhara proposes that if Ross Geller gives Marcel to Dr. Baldhara, Dr. Baldhara will start Marcel off against a blind rabbit and will give Ross Geller twenty percent of the gains.
